$comment: TASK-886 — the CROSS-LANGUAGE contract for guardrail per-tenant availability.
This file is the ONE artifact both sides are pinned against, exactly as
tests/contracts/resolved-asr-spec.fixture.json pins ResolvedAsrSpec across
packages/types/src/asr-spec.ts and apps/stt/src/stt/pipeline/spec.py.
TypeScript — packages/applications/src/services/guardrail-availability/
policy-catalogue.ts (the admin plane: what a platform admin
may select, and which direction a threshold tightens)
Python     — apps/guardrail/src/guardrail/core/availability.py (the
runtime plane: which checks a resolved selection turns on)
Every id here is a check name declared in services/screening.py's
_DECLARED_FAIL_MODES. That is the whole membership rule: a policy is
selectable if, and only if, a screening check reads the selection. Adding an
id with no reader would repeat the injectionScreeningCriteria defect this
same ticket removed — a declared knob that cannot move anything.
TASK-1050 W1 — each policy also declares its violation handling (README §9.3, §11.1):
allowedActions          the actions a platform admin may set (ignore | warn | block)
platformDefaultAction   the action when no tier says otherwise ('block' for the 8 classifier checks = today's behaviour)
locked                  catalogue lock: always enabled at platformDefaultAction, editable by NOBODY (medical_validation, OD-9)
defaultEnabled          the platform default on/off (the four judges ship OFF, OD-6; response_refusal stays off)
inboundRegions          which inbound region trusts the check screens; the two inbound judges screen DATA regions only (§10.2 A3)
platformDefaultDataRegionAction  for a check that screens both trusts inbound: what a flag on a DATA region does
('ignore' = today's FC-5b record-only; a platform admin may raise it, OD-12 / §11.1)
medical_validation and the four judges join the catalogue in TASK-1050; their screening readers land in W2a.
jailbreak_detection is INBOUND only (an injection classifier is not run on model output);
response_safety defaults to 'ignore' (recorded, no clinician notice);
platformDefaultCategoryActions  {label: action} a flag whose labels are all listed takes instead of
the check's action; it only RELAXES (never raises a region) and cascades label by label
(prompt_toxicity: privacy_violation -> 'ignore').
